capabilities: Parse markdown vocabulary and Q&A pairs into flashcards
Run study sessions with grading, direction flipping, and shuffling
Track statistics including streaks, heatmap, and accuracy
Highlight hardest words for focused review
Edit cards mid-session with changes synced to source files
extras: Free, open-source, and runs locally. Manifest description notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Streak freezes are capped at 5.
intentEvidence: when it came to actual revision, I was completely dependent on Anki.
motivation: The author was frustrated with copying text, formatting cards, and exporting decks to Anki for every study session, and wanted studying to happen directly inside Obsidian.
problem: Studying notes required copying content into separate flashcard software like Anki, creating constant friction between note-taking and revision.

relations.evidence: I was completely dependent on Anki.

summary: Flashcard study plugin that parses markdown lists and Q&A pairs into interactive recall sessions with SRS-like queues, statistics, and streak tracking.
